answer: What survives to the kernel is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The sonnet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the copper. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work, rewards vest against future work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
